timing: opened after completed experiment; search result had appeared during initial check
title: SSH: A Self-Supervised Framework for Image Harmonization
coverage: Already perturbs foreground/background appearances with multiple3D LUTs and uses content/reference cross-appearance combinations to train harmonization. Foreground/background color recombination or LUT manipulation is not a new operation.
difference_and_limit: This pilot tests fixed-classifier risk under global Equalize with exact processed-part marginal-preserving cross-pairing; this narrow audit differs from harmonization training, but without the hypothesized stable effect it is not a validated research contribution.
